name: NIH ChestX-ray14
description: NIH ChestX-ray14 is a large-scale chest radiograph benchmark for multi-label disease classification from frontal chest X-rays across 14 thoracic conditions.
evaluation_method: AUC, often reported per class and averaged across labels
notes: The dataset is widely used but labels are noisy and derived from report mining, so results depend heavily on preprocessing and label interpretation.

institutions: National Institutes of Health Clinical Center
